title: Lesson 15
description: Vocabulary from Lesson 15 — the perfect tense, including the perfects that stand in for ἔρχομαι, λέγω, and ὁράω.

cards.back: I have become, been (perfect of γίνομαι)
I have been raised, am risen (perf. pass. of ἐγείρω)
I have come to know (perfect of γινώσκω)
I have said, spoken (serves as the perfect of λέγω)
I have come, gone (serves as the perfect of ἔρχομαι)
I have seen (serves as the perfect of ὁράω)
I depend on, trust in (perfect active of πείθω)
I have died, I am dead (perfect of θνῄσκω)
